blocks.text: President Lee Jae Myung said Tuesday that low economic growth was the root cause of social unrest across Europe and that South Korea must learn from the turmoil. His remarks came as Europe has been grappling with a wave of protests stretching from Albania to Belgium, Italy, Portugal and Spain, alongside mass demonstrations in France, where thousands of people have been arrested in recent weeks. The grievances vary across the continent, ranging from rising living costs and strained public services in France and Belgium to housing shortages in Spain and Portugal and corruption in Albania.
